# Kite

> JavaScript/TypeScript scripts that create native iOS widgets, Shortcuts actions and Control Center controls. JSX describes native nodes; no React, DOM or Node runtime.

## Start here

- [Agent guide](https://juanbeniteza.github.io/kite-docs/agent-guide.txt): Output contract, supported surfaces and hard limits.
- [Complete documentation bundle](https://juanbeniteza.github.io/kite-docs/llms-full.txt): Guides, exact declarations and runnable examples in one text file.
- [Type declarations](https://juanbeniteza.github.io/kite-docs/types/index.d.ts): Exact public signatures.
- [Human overview](https://juanbeniteza.github.io/kite-docs/How-Kite-works.html): How scripts become widgets.
- [Troubleshooting](https://juanbeniteza.github.io/kite-docs/Troubleshooting.html): Common failures and recovery.
